info.title: Kuutti API
info.description: Free, non-commercial dating app for Finland. Every account is verified through a Finnish bank. Source: AGPL-3.0 with App Store exception.

blurhash.description: Placeholder the app paints before the thumb arrives (computed from the thumb).

rejectionReason.description: Set when state is rejected: the reason the owner is told.

appealable.description: The check rejected it and the owner may ask a person to look, once (POST /photos/{id}/appeal); never after sure nudity or a person's decision.

position.description: 0 is first in the owner's order; the main photo is the first approved one (ADR-009 §4).

caption.description: The line the owner picked for the photo (#296), or null; the words for it are the client's, per language. Null when absent, so an app that is newer than its API still reads the answer.

people.description: Faces the check counted as people present (the face threshold of ADR-006 §2).

setting.description: Indoors or outdoors when the check is sure enough of one; null otherwise.

scene.description: Where, the surest first; each a key of photos.description.scene.

objects.description: Activities, animals and objects, the surest first; each a key of photos.description.object.

description.description: What the photo check saw in the photo (#296), or null before the check ran or where none runs. Null when absent, so an app that is newer than its API still reads the answer.

decidedByStaff.description: True when a person decided, false when the automatic check did.

review.description: The moderation outcome; label names are not part of it.

PhotoVariant.description: thumb: 200×200 for lists. card: 800×1067 when a profile is opened. full: 1600 px long edge, requested only from the zoom screen.

photosNotShown.description: Oldest first; each goes after twelve months.

carefulCheckUntil.description: Until when new photos are checked more carefully; null when they are not.

lookedAtAgain.description: Whether a second member of staff reviewed it.

get.summary: Liveness and readiness in one answer
get.description: 200 when the database answers and committed migrations are applied; 503 with the same body when either fails.

Opened in the system browser by the app, with the SHA-256 of the app's verifier for this attempt (code_challenge, ADR-027). Redirects to the identification broker's bank chooser; the person comes back through /auth/callback and the app receives a one-time code by deep link.

schema.description: The app that will receive the one-time code by deep link.

parameters.description: The app that will receive the one-time code by deep link.
parameters.name: platform

schema.description: The language of the bank chooser (ui_locales); defaults to the request's.

parameters.description: The language of the bank chooser (ui_locales); defaults to the request's.
parameters.name: locale

schema.description: SHA-256 of this attempt's verifier, lowercase hex (ADR-027): only the app holding the verifier can exchange the code.

parameters.description: SHA-256 of this attempt's verifier, lowercase hex (ADR-027): only the app holding the verifier can exchange the code.
parameters.name: code_challenge

302.description: Redirect to the broker; where none is configured (a pull-request preview, ADR-014 §1), to kuutti://auth?error=auth_unavailable; when this address has sent too many requests or started too many sign-ins, or too many are under way at once (ADR-026), to kuutti://auth?error=auth_rate_limited with Retry-After.

503.description: No identification broker is configured (anywhere but a preview).

get.description: The registered redirect URI. Exchanges the code with the broker, derives the identity, applies the re-registration rule and redirects to the app's deep link with a one-time code. A state is answered once: its second return, at once or later, is auth_state_mismatch without a call to the broker. Never called by the app itself.

302.description: Redirect to kuutti://auth?code=… on success, or to kuutti://auth?error=<code> (auth_state_mismatch, auth_cancelled, auth_under_18, auth_banned, auth_suspended with &until=<date> when the suspension has an end, auth_cooldown with &until=<date>, auth_provider_error) so the app shows the refusal.

post.summary: Exchange the one-time code for a session
post.description: Single use, within 60 seconds of the callback, and only with the verifier whose SHA-256 the attempt's /auth/start carried (ADR-027); a wrong verifier leaves the code unspent. Answers with this device's access and refresh tokens; the app keeps both in secure storage.

401.description: Unknown, used or expired code, or a verifier that is not its attempt's (auth_code_used).

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this address (ADR-026 §1); Retry-After is the wait.

post.description: Presents the refresh token, receives a new pair; the old refresh token is retired. Presenting a retired token ends the device's session (session_revoked): sign in through the bank again.

401.description: Retired, revoked, expired or unknown refresh token (session_revoked).

204.description: The session is ended; both tokens stop working.

post.description: Recovery for a lost phone: every session of the account ends, including this one.

204.description: Every session of the account is ended.

get.description: Opened by the moderation panel. The same bank login as the app's, marked as a staff attempt: it resolves to an identity with a moderator role and creates nothing. The browser returns to the panel with a one-time code in the URL fragment, or with error=admin_not_allowed.

schema.description: The language of the bank chooser; defaults to the request's.

parameters.description: The language of the bank chooser; defaults to the request's.
parameters.name: locale

302.description: Redirect to the broker; when this address has sent too many requests or started too many sign-ins, or too many are under way at once (ADR-026), to the panel with error=auth_rate_limited in the fragment and Retry-After.

post.summary: Exchange a staff one-time code for an admin session
post.description: Single use, within 60 seconds. Eight hours, no refresh; sign in again afterwards.

403.description: admin_not_allowed: the role was taken away meanwhile.

429.description: rate_limited: too many requests from this address (ADR-026 §1); Retry-After is the wait.

200.description: The role and when the session ends.

get.description: The optional e-mail of #148 (TD-18): a way back in if a phone is lost, never a login, never shown to anybody. Null when none is set.

put.description: Validated as an address and nothing else; no mail is sent until SES exists (M5). The value reaches no log line and no event.

post.description: Erasure per TD-7: every session, login attempt, photo (with its objects unless another account shares them), review row and fetch log entry goes; the account row stays as an anonymised tombstone and the identity keeps a deletion count and a 30-day cooldown before a new account. The audit log is untouched. The body confirms; the app asks first.

204.description: Erased. Every token of this account has stopped working.

404.description: No live account: a second deletion that passed the session guard before the first committed (not_found).

post.summary: Take a break: pause this account
post.description: The account goes to paused (#170, ADR-022): the profile leaves every pool, counter and round, and every session of the account ends, this one included. Nothing is erased: the profile, the photos, the preferences, the consents and the place at the gate stay as they are, and the next bank login brings the account back as it was. The body confirms; the screen asks first.

204.description: Paused. Every token of this account has stopped working.

409.description: not_active: onboarding is not finished, so there is nothing to hide yet; already_paused: another device paused the account first.

get.summary: Everything Kuutti holds about this account
get.description: One zip, named <stem>-<date>.zip in the request's language: a JSON document (the AccountExport schema) with the account, the identity's dates and login level, the devices signed in, the photos with their moderation outcome and the person's own fetch log, and beside it photos/<photo id>.webp, the full-size file of every photo whose object the store holds. Nothing about anyone else. At most matching_config exports_per_day copies per Finnish calendar day; each photo read is logged as a fetch of the full variant.

200.description: The zip; Content-Disposition names the file.

schema.description: The zip with the document and the photos.

404.description: No live account: erased between the session guard and the record (not_found).

429.description: export_budget_exceeded: the day's copies are used up; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

get.description: In the owner's order, with the blurhash to paint before the bytes arrive.

200.description: The caller's own photos, with the advisory tips that apply to them, highest priority first (the app shows one at a time), and the fish the fish tip names, or null.

post.description: Multipart with one part named photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB). The API validates, strips metadata, re-encodes into three WebP variants and keeps no original. The photo is pending until moderation; the owner sees it, nobody else.

400.description: Validation failed (no photo part, or not an accepted type).

404.description: not_found: the account was erased while the photo was processed.

409.description: photo_limit: the account has max_photos photos already.

415.description: photo_unsupported: the bytes are not a JPEG, PNG or WebP.

422.description: photo_too_many_pixels or photo_invalid: refused before or by the decoder.

503.description: media_busy with Retry-After: image processing is at capacity; or media_unavailable.

204.description: Gone, along with its objects when nothing else shared them.

404.description: Not a photo of this account.

post.summary: Ask a person to look at the check's rejection
post.description: Once per photo, for a photo the automatic check rejected (`appealable`); never after a nudity label the check was very sure of, or a person's decision. The photo goes back to the queue and stays unseen by others until a person approves it.

404.description: Not a photo of this account.

409.description: photo_not_appealable: not the check's own rejection, or appealed already.

put.summary: Set the caption of a photo
put.description: A line from a closed list, shown under the photo to others in their own language (#296); null clears it. A key, never the person's text, so nothing is checked.

400.description: Validation failed: not a line of the list.

404.description: Not a photo of this account.

put.summary: Set the order of the photos
put.description: Every photo of the account exactly once, first to last. The main photo is the first approved one in this order (ADR-009 §4).

200.description: The photos in the new order, with the advisory tips that apply to them now that the main photo may have changed, highest priority first (the app shows one at a time), and the fish the fish tip names, or null.

get.summary: A signed URL for one variant
get.description: Valid for fifteen minutes. Every issuance is logged against the caller and counted against the day's budget for the variant (matching_config.photo_fetches_per_day; the day rolls at midnight in Finland). The app caches by photo id and variant, never by this URL, and asks for full only from the zoom screen. Another account's photo is served only from a card the caller was shown.

parameters.description: thumb: 200×200 for lists. card: 800×1067 when a profile is opened. full: 1600 px long edge, requested only from the zoom screen.
parameters.name: variant

200.description: The URL and when it stops working.

404.description: Not a photo this account may see: not its own, and not on a card it was shown.

429.description: photo_budget_exceeded: the day's fetches of this variant are used up; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

503.description: media_unavailable: no object storage is configured here.

get.summary: Photos waiting for a person's decision
get.description: Oldest first, with what the automatic check saw: labels with confidences, faces, what was flagged.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.summary: A signed URL for the card variant, for review
get.description: Any photo, any state. Every issuance is an audit_log row naming the member of staff.

200.description: The URL and when it stops working.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

503.description: media_unavailable: no object storage is configured here.

post.description: approve makes the photo visible to others; reject hides it and tells the owner the reason in words. Only a queued photo takes a decision, once. Only a person rejects. Written to audit_log.

400.description: Validation failed (a rejection without a reason, for example).

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

409.description: photo_not_queued: the photo is not waiting for a decision (already decided, or still being checked).

get.summary: The caller's profile and what it still needs
get.description: The profile as saved (null before the first save) and the completeness rule's verdict (what is missing before the profile can enter a round).

put.description: The whole document every time: display name, a bio or a placeholder, the fields from the registry, up to three prompts. A politics or religion answer needs the special-category consent on record, which is given at the seeks step and withdrawn in Settings (the consent routes), never in this body. Free text passes the plain-text rule: no e-mail, URL, phone number or social handle.

200.description: Saved; the profile as stored, with its completeness.

400.description: Validation failed, or text_contact_details (a field carries an e-mail, URL, phone number or handle).

403.description: consent_required: a politics or religion answer without the consent of the current wording (ADR-019); the detail names the fields and the current version.

get.summary: The caller's own card, as others will see it
get.description: The card built the way a round builds it for someone else, with the age from the bank-verified year and month, the approved photos in order (bytes through GET /photos/{id}/{variant}) and what is still missing. Nothing is recorded: this is the owner looking at themselves.

200.description: The card, or null before the first save.

get.summary: What the caller has answered and which steps of onboarding are still open
get.description: The steps of the field sheet in the order the app asks them, the answers so far, the consents given for the current wordings and the current versions. An account without a pond is put in the default pond here. When the four answers matching needs and the two consents are there and the account is still registered, it becomes active here; the profile steps keep `complete` false until they are done.

put.description: Self-declared, one of a closed list (rule 3); nothing from the bank informs it.

get.summary: Every consent the caller has given, and the current versions

post.summary: Record a consent for the current wording
post.description: The kind (terms, privacy, research, or special_category for whom one seeks, politics and religion), the consent_version the person read and the language it was shown in. An old version is refused with agreement_outdated; the same consent twice is recorded once.

409.description: agreement_outdated: the wording has a newer version.

429.description: too_many_changes: the research opt-in was given and withdrawn more than the day allows.

delete.summary: Withdraw the research opt-in or the special-category consent
delete.description: The two consents a person withdraws; terms and privacy end with the account. Withdrawing special_category takes whom the person seeks and the politics and religion of the profile with it, and onboarding asks the seek question again. The rows stay as the record of what was agreed and when.

400.description: Validation failed: not a kind a person withdraws.

post.description: A kind (bug, idea, complaint, praise) and a few lines, with the app's version, the platform and the language the app read. Stored for the moderators' panel; the text reaches no log line and no research event. At most matching_config feedback_per_day a day per account, the Finnish calendar day.

400.description: Validation failed: an unknown kind, an empty or too long text, an unknown platform.

404.description: No live account: erased between the session guard and the record (not_found).

429.description: feedback_budget_exceeded: the day's feedback is sent; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

get.description: The unhandled rows: a bug first and praise last, the oldest first within a kind, with the app's version, the platform and the language the app read, and the sender's account id.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

post.description: A moderator read it. Once; written to audit_log with the kind.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

post.summary: Block the person of a card one was shown
post.description: From then on neither is shown to the other, in either direction, in any round, card, photo or pool. Between the two identities, so it holds for a later account of either; final. Nobody is told.

204.description: The block stands: set now, set before, or set by the other first, alike.

400.description: Validation failed: a missing or malformed account id, an unknown key.

404.description: not_found: no card of that account was shown to the caller and no block stands between the two accounts (never shown, oneself, nobody, a later account of somebody blocked), or the caller was erased meanwhile; nothing is written.

post.summary: Report the person of a card one was shown, and block them
post.description: A reason from the closed list and, if the person likes, a few lines for the moderators, who read it in the panel. The report blocks both ways in the same transaction. The reported person learns nothing. At most matching_config reports_per_day a day per account, the Finnish calendar day; one open report per pair.

204.description: Filed and blocked; or a report of the same person is still open, and nothing more is written.

400.description: Validation failed: a missing or unknown reason, a note blank or over 500 characters, a malformed account id, an unknown key.

404.description: not_found: no card of that account was shown to the caller and no block stands between the two accounts (never shown, oneself, nobody, a later account of somebody blocked), or the caller was erased meanwhile; nothing is written.

429.description: report_budget_exceeded: the day's reports are filed and nothing was written, the block neither; Retry-After is the wait until the day rolls.

get.description: Newest first: the account's own and the identity's bans set on any of its accounts, with staff's notes and who did what by identity id and their role now (null once the role is gone, or for what no person did).

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

post.summary: Warn, shadow-ban or suspend a person
post.description: A reason from the closed list and a note of at most 500 characters; a suspension also its end, a day after today in Finland and at most 366 days ahead. A suspension ends every session. A ban is POST /admin/accounts/{id}/bans, for admins.

400.description: Validation failed, or ends_on_invalid: the end is not after today or too far ahead.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

409.description: account_deleted: only a ban binds an erased account; staff_target: a member of staff loses the role first.

post.description: Admins only. On the identity, for good until an admin lifts it: every session ends, the bank login is refused, and no new account is possible. An erased account's identity can be banned too.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

409.description: staff_target: a member of staff loses the role first.

post.summary: Lift a warning, a shadow ban or a suspension
post.description: The account is settled from what is still open; no session comes back, the person signs in again. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such sanction here (a ban is lifted on its own route).

409.description: sanction_lifted: already lifted; own_account: nobody lifts a sanction on themselves.

post.description: A second member of staff's note, and keep or lift. Somebody other than who applied it; once. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

404.description: No such sanction here (a ban is reviewed on its own route).

409.description: own_sanction: applied by the same person; own_account: a sanction on the reviewer; sanction_reviewed: looked at already; sanction_lifted: a lift of a lifted one.

post.description: The account is settled from what is still open; no session comes back, the person signs in again. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

409.description: sanction_lifted: already lifted; own_account: nobody lifts a sanction on themselves.

post.description: A second member of staff's note, and keep or lift. Somebody other than who applied it; once. Written to audit_log.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

409.description: own_sanction: applied by the same person; own_account: a sanction on the reviewer; sanction_reviewed: looked at already; sanction_lifted: a lift of a lifted one.

get.description: Each key of matching_config with its latest value, which every reader uses, and its versions newest first: the value, from when, by whom and why. Admins only.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

post.description: A new version of the key with the admin's reason, used from the next request on. The value keeps the current one's JSON type, and an object its keys. Keys are born in migrations. Admins only; written to audit_log.

400.description: Validation failed, or config_shape: the value changes the current one's type or keys.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

409.description: config_conflict: another admin changed the key meanwhile.

get.description: Per queue (photos waiting for a person, feedback not handled), how many wait and since when the oldest; the API's clock; and matching_config moderation_response_hours, past which the oldest is late. Moderators and admins.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.description: One account by its id: its raw state and the identity's standing, the profile as the card shows it, the photos (the pictures by GET /admin/photos/{id}/card), the feedback the person sent, and the audit rows about them. Never the hash, the broker's ids, the research id or the e-mail. An erased account answers its deletion date and nothing else. Every look is an audit row.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.summary: The audit log, a page at a time
get.description: Who did or saw what, newest first, 50 rows a page; narrowed by actor, action, subject type and id, and a time window; `before` is the `next` of the page before. Never more than a page. Admins only; a read narrowed to a subject id writes audit.read about it first, any other read writes nothing.

400.description: Validation failed, or cursor_invalid: a cursor this route did not give.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.description: Every member of staff by identity id: the role, when and by whom it was granted, the last sign-in to the panel. Granting and revoking stay the maintainer's tool. Admins only.

403.description: admin_forbidden: the role does not allow this.

get.summary: Where the caller stands at the pond gate
get.description: Between a finished profile and the first round (TD-10): on the pond's waitlist with a place, let in and waiting for enough people who match (how many more, in steps of `step`), or open. Counted nightly, and once when a person with a finished profile first asks.

Per pond: bank-verified people waiting, their split by self-declared gender, and how many are finishing their profile. A number is published only where at least k people stand behind it (k is in the answer), the split only when every cell is at least k, and a pond's numbers move only once at least k people have come or gone since they were last said. Counted once a day. No session needed.

200.description: Every pond with what may be said of it.

get.summary: The ponds a person can choose
get.description: Every pond with both Finnish case forms (TD-17), parents first. Where matching happens (TD-10); the choice is one per account.
Each with whether it is paused: a deal-breaker waits while the person's own answer on its field is missing (#149, the disclose-to-filter rule). `max` is how many a person may have.

put.description: The whole set, at most `max`, each on a distinct whitelisted field the person has answered themselves, accepting options the field has. Hard rows: #87 applies them in the pool, both ways.

400.description: Validation failed: more than allowed, a field twice, or an answer the field has not.

409.description: filter_unanswered: a deal-breaker on a field the person has not answered themselves (the log names the field, the screen knows it).

get.summary: Whom the caller seeks and the age window
get.description: The two hard filters of rule 7 as the person set them; null until onboarding sets them.

put.summary: Set whom the caller seeks, the age window, or both
put.description: Either or both, each replacing its row: a non-empty set of genders, an age window within 18 and 99 with min at most max. Onboarding saves each on its own screen (ADR-010 §13). Hard rows: the round builder never crosses them, in either direction.
